title: Voluntry
shortDescription: Voluntry is a web platform that connects students with volunteer events and helps organizers manage applications, participants, feedback, points, rewards, and certificates.
highlights: Separate student, organizer, and admin workspaces with role-based routing.
Volunteer event discovery, applications, participant tracking, and feedback management.
Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Storage, and Admin SDK integration.
QR-based certificate generation and verification for completed activities.
